download_model: download the rpa_ul_1024 model to the specified datapath using the download function
run_download: run the download function to fetch the rpa_ul_1024 model into a given data directory
summarize_download: summarize the download function which fetches the rpa_ul_1024 model via download_with_model_type
review_download: review the download function to understand how it delegates to download_with_model_type for model retrieval
test_download: test the download function by calling it with a datapath and verifying the model is fetched
